card.name: Partway through prescriber and similar role words
card.fires_on: The middle piece "cri" in "prescriber" in the antidepressant suicidality warning about contacting the prescriber. It also fires weakly on words that lead into a person or role noun, such as "American" before "who" or "obst" before "etrical personnel".

modes.label: Prescriber in warning
modes.description: The piece "cri" inside "prescriber" at the end of the caregiver communication sentence in antidepressant warnings.
modes.example: Families and caregivers should be advised of the need for close observation and communication with the pres<<cri>>ber.

modes.label: Words before a person noun
modes.description: A word that leads into a person or staff noun, such as a nationality before "who" or part of "obstetrical" before "personnel".
modes.example: CERVIDIL should be administered only by trained obst<<et>>rical personnel in a hospital setting

card.writes: It favors words for people and staff groups (members, personnel, managers) and suppresses "who"-type words.
card.plain: It fires inside the word prescriber, where the text is about to name a type of person or role.
